display_name: Performance Review Drafting and Calibration Preparation
description: Organize factual performance evidence into a balanced review draft and calibration notes; do not decide ratings, promotions, compensation, or employment actions.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when asked to draft a self-assessment, manager review, evidence-based feedback, development goals, or calibration preparation for a specified review period.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: review mode; subject reference; review period; published role expectations/goals; manager/self notes and verified work evidence; rating framework if applicable; intended reviewer.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: mode-specific review template/draft, source-linked evidence, development goals or calibration discussion points, explicit unknowns and owner decisions.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Choose self-assessment, manager review, or calibration mode; confirm period and governing role expectations. 2. Collect only authorized role-relevant evidence; distinguish direct observations, sourced outcomes, opinion and missing evidence. 3. Organize accomplishments using context/action/result; compare goals to evidence without overstating causality. 4. Draft strengths and development feedback as observable behavior plus impact and next action; avoid personality labels and unsupported claims. 5. If ratings are requested, use only the supplied scale and anchors; otherwise leave rating blank. Calibration summaries show counts/distribution only if authorized and use actual team denominator. 6. Exclude compensation recommendation unless explicitly requested and supported by the approved process; even then make it a separate option for owner review. 7. Return private draft; no HRIS updates, sharing, ratings finalization or employee communication.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
